comparison.objective: Fit and lock a T8 tube in two rotor lampholders.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually carry a long tube level, align both pin pairs, insert them simultaneously, and quarter-turn both rotors.
comparison.success_condition: Both ends inserted, rotors at 90 degrees, lamp lit, hands 30 mm clear, stable for 1 s; dropping fails.
comparison.reason: Long-part dual-ended insertion and rotary locking are meaningfully different from granular screening. No material rubric detail is missing.
